name: agent_wakes_on_a_row
title: Agents · an agent wakes when a row is added, once, and never on its own writes

steps.say: make a table named deals with each deal's name, its EBITDA in millions and its stage
steps.reply:
I've made the **Deals** table. It's empty for now and sits in a new area called **Deal Pipeline**. I couldn't call the area "Deals" as well, because an area and its table can't share a name.

It has three columns:
- **Name** is the deal's name and must be filled in.
- **EBITDA** is a number in millions. I've assumed US dollars, so tell me if you work in another currency.
- **Stage** is a pick-list. You didn't name your stages, so I used common ones: Sourcing, Screening, Diligence, LOI, Closed and Passed.

Send me your deals, either typed out or as a file, and I'll add them. I can also change t

steps.say: add a deal: Midwest HVAC, EBITDA 2.1, stage new
steps.reply:
I added **Midwest HVAC** to your Deal Pipeline with EBITDA of $2.1M.

The pipeline has no "New" stage. Its stages are Sourcing, Screening, Diligence, LOI, Closed and Passed, so I put the deal in **Sourcing**, the first one. If you'd like a separate "New" stage before Sourcing, I can add it and move the deal there.
